QUOTE: `skipSync: true` | add path (hardcoded) | `sanitizeReactions` returns early with `deleteReactions: []`, so the add event never deletes stale reactions for that post. Only the create set is computed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that skipSync stops deletion of other reactions on the post (the sync-diff treating the payload as complete set), and contrasts with full sync, which deletes local rows missing from the payload.
